Frequently asked questions

Are you a registered BAS Agent?

Yes. I’m a registered BAS Agent with the Tax Practitioners Board (registration number 26049564), so I can prepare and lodge your BAS and give BAS-related advice.

Do you offer bookkeeping in Boronia?

Yes — I’m based in Boronia (VIC 3155) and work with local businesses in Boronia, Bayswater, Ferntree Gully, The Basin, Knoxfield, Wantirna, Rowville and Croydon.

Can you do bookkeeping for businesses elsewhere in Melbourne?

Absolutely. With cloud software like Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks I look after small businesses right across Melbourne, with phone, email and video catch-ups.

What’s the difference between a bookkeeper and a registered BAS Agent?

A bookkeeper records and reconciles your transactions. A registered BAS Agent is also registered with the Tax Practitioners Board to prepare and lodge BAS, IAS and related returns with the ATO for a fee.

My books are a mess — is that a problem?

Not at all. Catch-up and clean-up work is a common starting point, including overdue BAS.

Do you work with my accountant?

Yes. I keep your records tidy so your accountant can finish year-end and tax returns faster.
